description: Zhou Yu, elegant chinese commander in the supplied pixel art style. Long black hair in a high ponytail with a red tie, a white fur collar, red and dark robe-armor with gold trim, dark boots. He holds a long straight sword in the right hand
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the long black ponytail falling down the back, the white fur collar, the long red robe with gold hem, the sword at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One diagonal downward cut. Frames 1-5 raise the sword and wind up; frame 8 the cut lands from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: One level horizontal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is taken far out to the right at chest height; frame 8 it cuts across level to the left; frames 9-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Thrust, then rising cut. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a straight thrust; frames 7-8 the sword drops low; frame 9 a rising cut; frames 10-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s4: Command with the sword. Frames 1-6 the sword is raised; frame 9 it is pointed sharply forward at the target, giving the order; frames 10-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sword stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → b1 → b2, 전법 s4. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
